chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a lone music box begins the tune softly with warm strings already sustaining beneath it}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
a gently detuned music box playing the tower's tune
a soft warm string bed sustaining underneath every bar
celesta doubling a sixteenth behind like a quieter twin
bittersweet, tender, lamplit, a quiet lamplit room with an empty chair
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
